rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Blast
rules.description: If the target is hit all models within 4“ of it are also hit by this weapon.

rules.name: Bravery Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to Morale Test rolls. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Brutal
rules.description: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Caster
rules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Devout
rules.description: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Enhanced Brutal
rules.description: If this model has Brutal, the target always takes hits on unmodified hit results of 6 from Brutal (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Devout
rules.description: If this model has Devout, the target always takes hits on unmodified hit results of 6 from Devout (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Devout Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Devout. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Fast Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Fortified
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Fortified Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fortified. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Hero
rules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

rules.name: Increased Shooting Range
rules.description: This model gets +6" range on its weapons when shooting.

rules.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +6" range on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Piercing Charge
rules.description: This model gets AP(+1) on its weapons when charging.

rules.name: Piercing Marksman
rules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+1).

rules.name: Piercing Marksman Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Piercing Marksman. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Precision Target
rules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when attacking them.

rules.name: Purge
rules.description: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, this weapon gets AP(+2).

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Regeneration Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Shred
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Shred in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shred on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Spell Conduit
rules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

rules.name: Unique Hero
rules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

spells.name: Burn the Heretic
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which loses 2 spell tokens. Note that the target may not spend those spell tokens to prevent this effect.

spells.name: Eternal Flame
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 3 hits with Purge.

spells.name: Holy Rage
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Piercing Marksman once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Litanies of War
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Devout once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Righteous Wrath
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 24" in line of sight, which takes 3 hits with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

spells.name: Searing Admonition
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with Blast(3).
